name: Niu Niu (Ox-Ox, Bullfighting)
description: Niu Niu (literally 'Ox Ox') is a popular gambling card game originating from Southern China and widely played in Southeast Asia. It is a banking game where players receive five cards and must split them into a three-card set (totaling a multiple of 10) and a two-card hand. The value of the two-card hand determines the strength of the 'Ox'. It is known for its fast pace, significant multipliers on high hands, and its ubiquity in Asian casinos and social gatherings.

content.text: Niu Niu (literally 'Ox Ox') is a popular gambling card game originating from Southern China and widely played in Southeast Asia. It is a banking game where players receive five cards and must split them into a three-card set (totaling a multiple of 10) and a two-card hand. The value of the two-card hand determines the strength of the 'Ox'. It is known for its fast pace, significant multipliers on high hands, and its ubiquity in Asian casinos and social gatherings.
Rooted in traditional Chinese gambling games like Pai Gow and Mahjong, Niu Niu was adapted for Western playing cards in the early 20th century. The 'Ox' (Niu) symbolizes strength and good luck.

items.text: Cambodia (land casino): Single deck; Equal and Double bets; 5% commission on wins; player may lose up to 3x on Double. Hand ranking: No Niu lowest, then 1-9 points, Niu Niu highest.

Online / Ultimate Niu Niu: Often six decks; dealer may set both hands (baccarat-style). Ultimate Niu Niu (five face cards) outranks Niu Niu; pays 4.75:1, loss pays 5x. Ties possible with multiple decks.
Reduced commission: Some Cambodia casinos charge 5% commission only on wins of 2:1 or more; 1:1 wins pay full. Lowers house edge.
